profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Proof
profile.summary:
Proficient in designing and developing custom software solutions to meet unique business needs. 

Expertise in integrating diverse systems through API connections, enabling seamless data exchange and process automation.

Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, ensuring reliable and secure operations.

positions.title: Jr. Linux Administrator
positions.description: Managed the help desk and helped artists troubleshoot various network, software, and hardware issues. Managed domain users and computers. Supervised the rendering process and managed the render farm.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Developed a Modeling Hub repository for K-12 teachers using web-development tools such as HTML, CSS, PHP, and SQL.  The Modeling Hub will help facilitate the implementation of mathematical modeling in K-12 Pomona Unified schools.

positions.title: Co-Teacher
positions.description: Taught web-development and design (HTML, JavaScript, CSS) to local high-school girls.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Conducted graduate-level research in spinal cord neurons to aid the nationwide efforts of studying the nervous system as part of the big data project inspired by President Obama known as the Brain Research through Advancing Innovative Neurotechnologies (BRAIN) initiative. 

Gained proficiency in utilizing techniques related to molecular genetics. 

Worked collaboratively to successfully visualize isolated populations of neurons and their projections.

positions.title: Summer Immersion Program Participant
positions.description:
Studied the fundamental concepts of computer science and applied them to projects developed in a collaborative setting. 

Gained exposure to the technology and innovation at work within various industries.

projects.title: Un-bordered.
projects.description:
Created a mobile-friendly web app titled "Un-bordered"​, which combats stigma against immigration. 
Features include:

(1) a map on the homepage with markers to indicate a person's hometown and current location (this was made using the Mapbox API) 
(2) statistics on the homepage which debunk common stereotypes about immigration 
(3) a game in which the user is placed in the shoes of a first-generation student and must make life-based decisions 
(4) a platform on which users can submit their immigration stories

organizations.description: A Better Chance (ABC) is an organization whose mission is to help competent young people of color gain opportunities by helping them apply to and attend the nation's top high schools.
